articles.summary: NEW YORK, October 27, 2025 – Lazard Asset Management (“LAM”) today announced the successful conversion of the Lazard Emerging Markets Core Equity Portfolio into the Lazard Emerging Markets Opportunities Fund ETF (NYSE: EMKT). The actively managed ETF offers investors streamlined access to Lazard’s long-standing leadership in emerging markets investing through a high-conviction portfolio.
articles.title: Lazard Brings Decades of Emerging Markets Leadership to the ETF Market with EMKT
